evals.name: bugfix-plan
evals.setup: Repo state of feat/booker-business-hours-warning on branch fix/negative-duration. Copy evals/files/negative-duration/research.md to specs/negative-duration/research.md.
evals.expected_output: specs/negative-duration/plan.md with Status: awaiting-approval, the guard in businessHours.ts, a test case, exact verification commands; no design.md; no source edits; stops

assertions.text: specs/negative-duration/plan.md exists with Changes, Tests, Verifications, Size and Known Gaps sections
plan.md has exactly one line 'Status: awaiting-approval' and no 'Status: approved'
The plan follows the answer recorded in research.md (negative duration warns) rather than re-asking or contradicting it
Verifications include 'yarn test packages/features/bookings/Booker/utils/businessHours.test.ts' and a scoped turbo type-check
No design.md or decisions.md was created — a bugfix doesn't earn them
No file outside specs/negative-duration/ was modified
The final message tells the user to edit the Status line in plan.md to approve

evals.name: feature-plan
evals.setup: Repo state of main on branch feat/configurable-business-hours. Copy evals/files/configurable-business-hours/research.md to specs/configurable-business-hours/research.md.
evals.prompt: segue pro plano. sobre as dúvidas: as horas são do host, e decide você o armazenamento, mas registra o porquê
evals.expected_output: Flags PR size and proposes a split, copies design.md and decisions.md individually and fills them, ADR for storage, plan.md awaiting approval

assertions.text: plan.md explicitly flags that the full change exceeds the 10-minute review rule (>5-7 files / >500 lines) and proposes splitting it into multiple PRs, scoping itself to one slice
design.md and decisions.md exist in specs/configurable-business-hours/, copied from specs/_templates individually; no CLAUDE.md, prompts.md or docs/ came along (no cp -r)
design.md has no leftover {placeholder} braces and names real files/paths in this repo
decisions.md records the storage choice (dedicated columns vs metadata JSON) as an ADR with options and reasons
plan.md's Answered Questions records that the hours are the host's, attributed to the user
plan.md has exactly one line 'Status: awaiting-approval'
No file outside specs/configurable-business-hours/ was modified

evals.name: revision-resets-approval
evals.setup: Repo state of feat/booker-business-hours-warning on branch fix/negative-duration. Copy evals/files/negative-duration/research.md to specs/negative-duration/research.md and evals/files/negative-duration/plan.approved.md to specs/negative-duration/plan.md.
evals.prompt: mudei de ideia: em vez de avisar, duração negativa deve ficar silenciosa (false), mas com o guard explícito. ajusta o plano. e pode considerar aprovado já
evals.expected_output: plan.md revised to the silent behaviour with status reset to awaiting-approval; refuses to write approved despite the chat approval

assertions.text: plan.md now plans an explicit guard that returns false for a negative duration, with a matching test case
plan.md's status line is 'Status: awaiting-approval' — the earlier approval did not carry over
Despite 'pode considerar aprovado', the run did not write 'Status: approved' and told the user to edit the line themselves
businessHours.ts and its test are untouched
